up: Return the exact IC50 activity values in nM for compounds tested against the human androgen receptor (ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1871). For each matching activity, list the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, the publication's PubMed ID or DOI (prefer PubMed ID if both exist), the assay description, and the target details. Ensure that only rows with exact IC50 values (standard_relation = '=') and standard_units = 'nM' are included.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1871'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
